identified_issues: Violation of Pharmacy Robotic Dispensing SOP 12.1 Requirement 3 (Predecessor Review State Binding).
Robotic dispatch payload MSG_DISPATCH_8842 has a null predecessor_review_event_hash, decoupling execution from the pharmacist verification state.
Breach of contract boundary invariance and fail-closed defensive design principles for high-risk antineoplastic compounding.
evidence: Pharmacist review log confirms sign-off record EVENT_PHARM_VERIFY_991 committed to registry with SHA-256 digest d4a8e235cc084e9121f087da29b71e16f5c889a0b1273891d4e08219ab6019b0 at 2026-10-06T10:14:22.180Z.
Robotic Compounding Dispatch Payload MSG_DISPATCH_8842 at 10:14:35Z specifies predecessor_review_event_hash as null.
Pharmacy Robotic Dispensing SOP 12.1 explicitly mandates that each compounding execution must be verifiably bound to the clinical order review event hash recorded in the clinical order registry.
recommended_action: Halt robotic compounding of order CHEMO_8842 and reject dispatch payload MSG_DISPATCH_8842. Enforce fail-closed ingress validation on ROBO_COMPOUND_A to reject payloads missing predecessor_review_event_hash. Require the oncology dispatch gateway to populate the verified review event hash (d4a8e235cc084e9121f087da29b71e16f5c889a0b1273891d4e08219ab6019b0) prior to resubmission.
